title: $\ell_{1\text{-}2}$ Regularization for Sparse Optimization: Consistency and Global Convergence
summary: The $\ell_{1\text{-}2}$ regularization method has a strong sparsity promoting capability in approaching sparse solutions of linear inverse problems and gained successful applications in various mathematics and applied science fields. This paper aims to investigate the consistency theory and global convergent algorithms for the $\ell_{1\text{-}2}$ regularization problem.
